answer: One concrete mechanism: measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The sonnet of work and the atlas of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a comet to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
